Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.Summary & Role Information:Join SAP Cloud Infrastructure and help build the next generation of cloud services and platform capabilities powering SAP's sovereign and regulated cloud environments.As a Product Security Senior Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our Cyber Defense capability — coordinating and steering our external managed SOC partner, integrating security tooling into our cloud operations stack, and ensuring consistent detection, response, and monitoring across 30+ regional datacenters globally, from Australia to Toronto. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.What You'll Do:- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure tooling coverage keeps pace with platform expansion into new regions.- Coordinate incident response processes between the external SOC, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations. Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.What You Bring:Technical Foundation- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.Core AI Skills- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.Professional Skills- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.Tech You Bring- SIEM/SOAR platforms- Logging and monitoring tooling- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms- Kubernetes ecosystem- GitHub for configuration and issue management- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages- Cloud computing environments- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana- Threat intelligence platforms- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNowMeet the Team:You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We work on real infrastructure problems, share what we learn, and believe a private cloud is something you build, not something you rent.​Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Siemens AG.What we offer you- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefitsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.- Partner for Portfolio and Product Management and the CVE community:- You act as partner for Portfolio and Product Management functions within Siemens AG to identify and initiate CVE projects.- You promote value-driven thinking across Cost and Value Engineering and relevant business functions.- You are part of the CVE community as expert for Value Management and Value Engineering methods.Your success is grounded in- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.- Ways of working:- You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills and can quickly understand complex structures and interdependencies.- You bring a strategic and customer-centric mindset and can translate complex business challenges into sustainable value creation opportunities.- You manage projects and time effectively, facilitate workshops professionally, and support acquisition activities with confidence.- Knowledge of Siemens products and systems in Smart Infrastructure is an advantage.- Willingness to occasionally travel, approx. 20%.- Languages: You have excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usEvery day at Siemens, thousands of processes take place involving the ordering, processing, storage, and delivery of a wide variety of materials, raw materials, and products. Our Supply Chain experts keep a close eye on every movement from A to B. How can our digital processes help us operate more efficiently, effectively, and adaptively? What challenges and opportunities do we see in shaping a sustainable future worldwide? Join us in finding the answers to these questions!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/)  – if you need further information on the application process.

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. improvement of our QA processesKeys to SuccessEducation:- Completed vocational training as PTA, PKA, CTA, Pharmaceutical Assistant or a comparable qualification- No university degree requiredExperience & Skills- Experience in pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, Quality Control or another GMP-regulated environment is an advantage- Good understanding of GMP/GDP requirements-
